record.original_question: Besides barycentric subdivisions, are there other classes of simplicial complexes for which the corresponding Artinian reductions satisfy the same almost Lefschetz pattern described earlier: for a generic linear system of parameters Theta and a generic linear form w, the maps w^{d-2k-1}: (S/(I + (Theta)))_k -> (S/(I + (Theta)))_{d-1-k} are injective for k <= (d-1)/2, and the maps w^{d-2k-1}: (S/(I + (Theta)))_{k+1} -> (S/(I + (Theta)))_{d-k} are surjective for k <= (d-1)/2?

evidence.quote: Question 4.6. Are there other classes of simplicial complexes (different from barycentric subdivisions) that satisfy (i) and (ii) above?

(i) ×w^{d−2k−1} : (S/(Isd(Γ) + (Θ)))_k → (S/(Isd(Γ) + (Θ)))_{d−1−k} is injective for k ≤ (d − 1)/2; (ii) ×w^{d−2k−1} : (S/(Isd(Γ) + (Θ)))_{k+1} → (S/(Isd(Γ) + (Θ)))_{d−k} is surjective for k ≤ (d − 1)/2.

artifact.status_search_result: The almost strong Lefschetz property for barycentric subdivisions of shellable complexes was established by Kubitzke–Nevo (2007). The question of identifying other classes of simplicial complexes whose Artinian reductions enjoy the same almost-Lefschetz injectivity/surjectivity pattern appears to be an open research direction; recent works on edgewise subdivisions and related constructions explore Lefschetz-type properties, but no complete classification or definitive answer was found.

status_evidence.title: The Lefschetz property for barycentric subdivisions of shellable complexes
status_evidence.snippet: An 'almost strong Lefschetz' property holds for the barycentric subdivision of a shellable complex.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the almost strong Lefschetz property for barycentric subdivisions of shellable complexes, motivating the question of which other classes share this property.
